professionalSummary: Platform owner for a parcel carrier’s delivery division, managing a multi‑account AWS environment for 2½ years. Responsible for all production infrastructure changes, Terraform code, deployment pipelines, cost controls, and change board leadership. Proven track record of coordinating with service teams and finance to ensure smooth, auditable platform operations.
experienceHighlights: Owned the delivery division’s cloud platform (AWS, three accounts) and personally approved and executed all production infrastructure changes.
Maintained Terraform code, deployment pipelines for tracking and dispatch services, and cost controls including account budgets, tagging policy, and monthly right‑sizing passes.
Chaired the fortnightly change board with four service team leads, deciding production windows and documenting minutes.
Collaborated with service teams and finance to record decisions on service configuration, budget approvals, and platform changes.
Documented all changes and maintained runbooks with post‑change hand‑over points.
projectsAndWorkSamples: Service‑catalogue page listing candidate as platform owner and a month of change records approved and executed under candidate’s user ID, with change‑tool identifiers for traceability.
skills: AWS (multi‑account management), Terraform, CI/CD pipelines, cost management, change management, cross‑functional collaboration, documentation, runbook maintenance

They do not provide evidence of interactions with security functions or detailed runbook updates beyond the change board minutes.

evidence.text: Reference call with the former head of engineering: the candidate was the platform owner of record, made and executed the production changes, chaired the change board; dates confirmed.

evidence.text: Kept the Terraform code, the deployment pipelines for the tracking and dispatch services and the cost controls (account budgets, the tagging policy and a monthly right-sizing pass) in shape.

evidence.text: Chaired the fortnightly change board with the four service team leads; I decided what went into the production window and kept the minutes.

evidence.text: Worked changes through with the service teams and finance; the minutes record that service configuration stayed with the service teams, budget approval with finance, and the platform and the production window with me.
